purpose: corrected diagnostic-only B300 FP32-both tail study; never whitelist promotion authority

pre_registered.balanced_order: even pair C1 first, odd pair pinned first
pre_registered.timing_contract: select_path, route-count snapshots, and CUDA Event construction are outside; after start.record/start.synchronize and before end.record/end.synchronize, the only invoked operation is candidate._call(public_fn, x, initial, final, gpu, cpu); route accounting, decision inspection, elapsed_time, and raw-pair recording are outside
pre_registered.relative_candidate_gate: all six repeats: C1 wins P50/P95/P99 and each margin >=2%
pre_registered.corrected_tail_rule: all six repeats: C1 p99 <=1.20ms, paired delta p99 <=0ms, joint(C1>pinned and C1>1.20ms)=0
pre_registered.telemetry_policy: per-main-process GPU state and separate telemetry sidecar are explanatory only and excluded from every gate
pre_registered.allocation_policy: second independent allocation is eligible only after all first-allocation gates pass; any relative margin failure stops
